_why: The real shape and the real types of the page's own state, measured on a live /reports/export DURING a real export (GH-470, PLAN-GH439 section 10.6, ninth refinement). The test poisoning answers Object.keys() from `shapes` and decides which paths must be poisoned as numbers or booleans from `types` — neither is a hand-kept list. A path that is not here enumerates as empty, and that case belongs to the static reader; the limit is recorded rather than implied.
_how: window.GAIP_STATE is a getter (gilba-hub-v2.js) that merges the last object a setter was given into every read, so a snapshot taken at one moment is not what the export sees later. The getter was wrapped and watched across a real export: 3,695 reads. The six named result containers answered: mlsnResults string, tissueResults object, waterResults string, shadeMetrics object, wearMetrics object, fertility undefined. Five live, one dead — which is the reviewer's measurement, reproduced here rather than taken on trust.
